mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS sectionId, C.NR_ITEM_ID AS id, C.NR_ITEM_NM AS name, 'nr-execute-1' AS parentId, C.NR_ITEM_ID AS mdfmCpemNo, 'ATTRIBUTE' AS classType, 'LABEL' AS controlType, NULL AS maskingType, C.NR_ITEM_NM || '-' || A.NRAT_FMT_FRQN_KND_CD || '회' AS content, NULL AS "desc", NULL AS style FROM ODS.S_MRNNRAAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRAAE B ON A.NRAT_FMT_ITEM_ID = B.NRAT_FMT_ITEM_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.LST_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON A.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.PACT_TP_CD || '_' || A.PT_NO || '_' || A.UITM_DT = #{keyId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.NR_ITEM_NM

SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS sectionId, B.NRAT_FMT_ID AS id, C.NR_ITEM_NM AS name, B.FMT_HMI AS time, A.NR_ITEM_ID AS parentId, B.NRAT_FMT_ID AS mdfmCpemNo, 'VALUE' AS classType, 'TEXT_BOX' AS controlType, 'NAME' AS maskingType, LEFT(B.FMT_HMI, 2) || ':' || RIGHT(B.FMT_HMI, 2) || '/' || B.FMT_SGNT_TP_CD || ' (' || (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.LSH_STF_NO) || ')' AS content, NULL AS "desc", NULL AS style FROM ODS.S_MRNNRAAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRAAE B ON A.NRAT_FMT_ITEM_ID = B.NRAT_FMT_ITEM_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.LST_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON A.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.PACT_TP_CD || '_' || A.PT_NO || '_' || A.UITM_DT = #{keyId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.NR_ITEM_NM, B.FMT_HMI
